Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Mithras
Clan: Ventrue
Group: 6
Capacity: 11
Discipline: DOM FOR OBF POT PRE
Camarilla Prince of London: Each turn, Methuselahs can play only one master card each. Mortals and mages can't block Mithras. +2 bleed.

World of Darkness reference: A World of Darkness 2nd Edition. This is Mithras before he was diablerized by Monty Coven. An alternative would be to make a advanced version of Monty Coven that would have some Ventrue traits as Mithras is taking control of Monty after the diablerie.
Mithras is a very powerful vampire, considered as a god by many mortals, capable of killing many werewolves. He's also a ruler and organizer (thus his control that limits "actions" taken by other Methuselahs)

How does this card address a compelling game need? Group 5-6 has only 1 Ventrue with Obfuscate (Graham Gottesman). Instead of introducing another Inner Circle for group 6, an alternative could be to introduce famous 4-5th gen vampires as 11-capacity vampires. His ability to limit master cards is fit a vampire rather than a generic card for decks built around a table-control strategy.

Created by: Ankha

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
